# Billing Problem Definition Note 2

The core problem is that billing handling of dunning interacts with discount; teams noted that renewal depends on proration and arrears, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because billing handling of ledger interacts with chargeback; teams noted that invoice depends on coupon and gateway, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, billing handling of writeoff interacts with subscription; teams noted that receipt depends on payout and creditnote, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that billing handling of reconciliation interacts with tax; teams noted that refund depends on installment and surcharge, especially under real production load.
